hook: Investigative journalists have won awards for pioneering AI applications in investigative journalism, making investigations more efficient and scalable.

sections.voiceover: Investigative journalists have won awards for pioneering AI applications in investigative journalism, making investigations more efficient and scalable.
This year, one award-winning application has made investigations more efficient and scalable, reducing processing time by 30%.
But the real number is worse: the application can now process 10,000 investigations per day, up from 5,000 last year.
The impact is significant, with a potential to transform the investigative landscape.
Investigative journalists are at the forefront of this transformation, and their pioneering work is paving the way for even greater advancements in the future.
